title: CharacterProfile
description: Structured character definition optimized for JoyAI-Echo text prompts. Generated from reference images via a separate Character Definition Tool.

age_appearance.description: Perceived age (Young adult, Elder, Child, etc.)

physical_description.description: Detailed visual description optimized for JoyAI-Echo. Include build, fur/skin, face, hair, posture, distinctive features.

distinctive_features.description: Unique visual traits (ear movement, expressions, gait, etc.)

timbre.description: Voice quality description (e.g. Clear young male voice with mischievous quality)

tone.description: Overall tone and personality in voice

personality_traits.description: Key personality traits that influence behavior and expressions

reference_version.description: Version of the reference images used (e.g. v1, v2)

locked_date.description: Date when character visual was locked

notes.description: Any additional notes for prompt engineering or consistency
